text: Neha is vegan now, properly, not just at home. Worth remembering before I suggest the steak place again.
Dev invited us to his housewarming next Saturday. New flat is in Walthamstow, top floor, no lift. I should bring something nicer than supermarket wine.

Lukas has a half marathon in Bristol at the end of the month. He's been training since the summer, out every morning before work, but his knee keeps flaring up and he sounds pretty nervous about it. His physio told him to take it easy this week and he's ignoring her, obviously. Text him good luck the night before, and maybe offer to drive him down if Chiara can't.
Chiara can't eat gluten. Coeliac, not a preference, so no shared toaster when she stays over.
Samir's band is playing the Lexington on Friday. He and his girlfriend Joy are both on the guest list thing, apparently, and he asked if I'd come along.

Bridget's dinner party is off. Her husband Aurelio was rushed into hospital on Sunday night with appendicitis and had surgery first thing Monday. She sounded shattered on the phone, she's been back and forth with the kids and hasn't eaten properly. Need to call her tomorrow and see how they're both doing, and drop off a lasagne at some point this week.
Jun said his daughter has her first piano recital sometime next week. He's more nervous than she is.
Santiago only drinks mezcal these days, neat, with orange slices. Gift idea for his birthday in early March.
Hamza Ibrahim, Hams to everyone at five a side, is getting married over the summer. Engagement drinks at the Crown this Thursday.
Ordered the cake for my own party. Collect it Friday after work, then pick up ice on the way home.
Angela mentioned her son Finn got into the county under-15 squad. First match is in a fortnight. Must ask her how it went.
Ayesha hates coriander with a passion. Says it tastes like soap. Also doesn't drink, so get her something decent and non-alcoholic for the barbecue.

Reza and Marta are hosting a Diwali dinner next Tuesday. They asked everyone to bring a dessert, and they're doing the whole spread themselves, biryani, dal, three kinds of pickle. Reza's parents are coming down from Bradford for it, which Marta is quietly nervous about because it's the first time she's hosted them. I'm making the pistachio cake again, since it went down so well last year.
Quick one: Henrik is lactose intolerant. Oat milk in the fridge before he visits this weekend.
Svetlana's daughter Mila has a ballet exam on Saturday morning. Svetlana is more stressed than Mila, honestly. Mila apparently just wants to get it over with and go for pancakes.
Lars told me his dad passed away last month. The funeral was quiet, family only. He seemed okay but tired. I should take him for a pint sometime next week.
Chris won the pub quiz league with his team last night. Third year running. He's insufferable about it, in the nicest way.
Miriam is hosting book club at hers at the end of the month. She's doing a Moroccan theme and wants us all to bring a dish. Don't forget to ask her what's already covered.
Alfie's school play is next Wednesday evening. He's playing the Grinch and has been practising the voice all week. Isabel says he's terrified of forgetting his lines.
Andre is doing keto again. No bread, no rice, no beer. Lasted two weeks last time.
Got invited to Abdi and Fiona's anniversary dinner, ten years. It's at the Italian place on the high street, Sunday the 2nd. Need to find a card and maybe something for the house.
Petra has tickets for the Arctic Monkeys in Manchester early December. She asked if I want the spare. Let her know by Friday.
Ines said her brother Aurelio is running the Berlin marathon next autumn. He's already obsessing over carb loading and refuses all alcohol until then.
Alana loves really strong black coffee and anything with cardamom. She dropped a hint that a decent grinder would go down well for Christmas.
Remember to buy more oat milk, bin bags and batteries. Also book the car in for its MOT sometime next week.
Lukas came round for dinner. He's been off meat for three months now and says he feels loads better. His partner Chiara still eats everything, which makes cooking at theirs interesting.
Neha got the part! She's playing Viola in Twelfth Night at the community theatre. Opening night is in early February. Send her flowers.
Dev's cat Biscuit had surgery on Monday to remove a growth. Dev was in pieces. Check on him tomorrow and see how Biscuit is recovering.
Jun Nakamura from work has invited the whole team to his leaving drinks next Friday. He's off to a startup in Lisbon. Need to chip in for the card and present.

Samir's mum is turning seventy at the end of the month. They're throwing a surprise party at a community hall in Leicester, with a caterer doing proper Gujarati food because she refuses to eat anything 'too fancy'. Samir asked me to keep it quiet around his sister Neha, who apparently can't keep a secret to save her life. I said I'd help set up the decorations on the Saturday morning.
Bridget mentioned she's allergic to shellfish. Badly, carries an EpiPen. Note for the Christmas meal.
Chris and his wife are doing a charity 10k in a fortnight. They've raised nearly two grand. I should sponsor them before the weekend.

Santiago's wedding is cancelled. He and Ines broke up a few weeks ago, and he only told me tonight over dinner. He's staying with his brother Andre in Croydon for now and doesn't want to talk about it yet. He was very quiet, barely touched his food, and kept checking his phone. I should invite him to the gig on Friday so he's not sat at home on his own.
Followed up with Angela about the dinner on Saturday. She said it went brilliantly and her in-laws finally liked something she cooked.
Ayesha is running her first ultra in the Peak District this weekend. Fifty kilometres. She's been weirdly calm, which is not like her. Message her on Sunday evening to ask how it went.
Reza only drinks Guinness. Won't touch lager.
Henrik said his wife Svetlana is expecting their second, due early April. Their eldest is thrilled. Need to send congrats.
Mila's nan is ninety on Tuesday. Big family lunch planned for the weekend after.
Hamza's brother Abdi is moving to Glasgow sometime next month for a new job. Hamza seems quite down about it, they've lived together for years.

Marta told me she's been struggling at work since the restructure. Her boss keeps piling things on, she's covering two roles, and she's barely sleeping. She has a review with HR next Thursday and is dreading it. She also mentioned she's started running again to cope, which is something. Ring her this weekend, even just for a chat, and ask how the review went afterwards.
Lars plays bass in a covers band. They've got a gig at the Railway on Saturday the 15th and he asked me to bring a few people.
Andre's daughter starts at the new primary after half term. She's a fussy eater, only plain pasta and cucumber, so packed lunches are a battle.
Miriam's pug Pickle went missing yesterday afternoon. They found him this morning in a neighbour's shed. She was frantic, but all fine now.
Joy is doing Dry January early this year, starting next week. She'll still come to the pub but just orders lime and soda.

Alfie and his sister Petra both had their swimming gala today. Alfie won his heat in the backstroke, Petra came third in freestyle, and both of them were absolutely starving afterwards and demolished a whole tray of chips. Their dad, Lukas, was beaming the whole time and filmed every single race. The county finals are sometime in January if they qualify. Ask Lukas for the photos.
Promised Isabel I'd make the trifle for her mum's birthday dinner on Sunday. Need sherry, custard and those sponge fingers.
Fiona is pescatarian but eats chicken at weddings, apparently. Her rules, not mine.
Isabel said Alana is nervous about her driving test on Thursday. Third attempt. Text Alana good luck on Wednesday night and again that morning.
Abdi has a big work presentation to the board next Monday. He's been rehearsing every evening this week. Find out how it went on Tuesday.
Went to Dev's gig last night. Small crowd, but they were great. He said they're recording an EP over the summer.
Chiara is hosting a tasting evening for her new wine bar, sometime late November. Invites to come later this week.
Svetlana's son is in the regional chess championship this weekend. He's twelve and apparently plays online for hours every night.
Neha's partner Finn has a gluten-free diet and hates mushrooms. Making risotto for them on Friday, so swap to a squash one.
Nothing much to note. Long chat with Henrik about football. He's still bitter about the derby.
Petra's housewarming got moved from this Saturday to the one after. She said the boiler packed in and the landlord is dragging his feet. I'm bringing the folding chairs either way.
Uncle Reza's hip replacement went well on Tuesday. He's home now but grumpy about the walking frame. Pop round with soup at the weekend.
Mrs Haddad next door asked if I'd feed her cat over half term. She's visiting her sister in Beirut for a week.
Bridget and her partner are going to the Hamilton matinee tomorrow, a birthday treat for Bridget. She's been wanting to see it for years.

Chris mentioned his niece is graduating from Leeds in early July. He's flying back from Dubai for it, landing the Wednesday before, then straight up north on the train. Before all that, he's at the Spurs game this Saturday, his work Christmas do is the week after, and he's back to Dubai on Monday morning. He still found time to recommend a new Lebanese place in Soho. Busy man.

Must book a table for Saturday night. Eight people, somewhere that does good vegan options for Neha and something without nuts for Jun, whose allergy is serious. Hamza wants somewhere with decent cocktails, and Ayesha doesn't drink so mocktails would be nice too. Try the Turkish place first, then the tapas bar if they're full.
